objective: Implement a candidate-only, cutoff-safe configurable recent-form producer and chronological S30 same-family evaluation for the preregistered 3/5/7/10 (plus sensitivity 15) and exponential candidates; do not select from 2026 or activate production.
required_tests: same candidate configuration gives deterministic replay
sealed current CE state and current production outputs unchanged
required_evidence: 2024 fold metrics and frozen 2025 validation metrics by pooled/year/role
paired period bootstrap or predeclared robustness comparison
state/config hash and future target-free smoke run
acceptance_criteria: all candidate features are reproducible using only pre-lock history
no current production model, optimizer, dashboard or active state changes
one candidate is promoted only if the predeclared R17A gate passes; otherwise current last-5 remains
outputs preserve enough metadata to recreate inference later
stop_conditions: canonical history cannot distinguish event time from target-period outcomes
common 2024-2025 evaluation rows cannot be built
candidate behavior is non-deterministic or requires target-period data
a requested change would mutate active production state or outputs
